headline: ChinaTalk examined why Russia is doing badly in Ukraine as both sides rebuild around drones and long-range strike, Australia unveiled new Ghost Shark underwater drone payloads, and Wired found hundreds of AI apps hiding sexually abusive deepfake features.

points.text: ChinaTalk's WarTalk examined why Russia is doing badly in Ukraine, as both sides rebuild their armies around drones, deception, and long-range strike.
Australia's navy unveiled previously secretive payloads being fielded on its Ghost Shark extra-large autonomous underwater vehicles.
The ITU's AI for Good argued that trustworthy AI begins with securing the AI stack and building resilience.
Wired uncovered roughly 400 AI apps and websites, linked to Chinese-language developers, that disguised secret features letting users generate sexually abusive and violent deepfake images and video.
An essay argued that the reach and influence of Claude's Constitution shows why AI's governing rules need public oversight and independent evidence that models actually follow them.
